decision: Did the nine action-relative features add held-out physical-HIT signal beyond the six portable state-only features in the frozen positive L2 probe?

diagnosis.validation_use: load reused validation exactly once after serializing the train-only state-only fit; do not tune or claim independent confirmation

gate.primary: at least one frozen supported HIT horizon has a complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint below zero for full minus state-only Brier
gate.shield_comparison: secondary attribution reported at every horizon

hypotheses.H1_incremental_action_signal: At one or both already-supported 16/64-frame physical-HIT horizons, the frozen full current-root/action probe has a complete-episode bootstrap upper bound below zero for Brier minus an otherwise identical state-only ridge probe.
hypotheses.H2_state_signal_only: If H1 fails after exact source reproduction, retain the state-only current-root risk representation and do not claim that the pilot established action-relative HIT information.
hypotheses.H3_reused_holdout_limit: This attribution reuses validation episodes whose full-model scores are already known. It may select the next bounded representation question but cannot serve as independent confirmation or online promotion evidence.

non_goals: no new feature, target, horizon, regularization, model class, optimizer, corpus, or split
no counterfactual successor, causal action-effect claim, actor, critic, reward, IQL, OPE, history, object encoder, or Wine run
no tuning from the already observed validation result and no claim of independent confirmation
calibration bins and per-episode deltas are descriptive attribution only and cannot alter the frozen decision
